summary: Steel lookout tower bought in fiscal 1947–48 and erected in fiscal 1948–49 with a cabin, engine house and road; Alberta's layer dates the present 18 m tower to 2004.

facts.design: Steel lookout tower, 18 m (59 ft) tall in the Alberta layer; the 1948–49 tower was steel and stood at the site with a cabin and an engine house

notes_for_editor: The 1947 and 1948 entries come from a hobbyist transcription (Canada Lookouts) of Alberta Department of Lands and Mines annual reports; the primary reports were not read. The page labels the 1948 entry as 1948 but cites the report for the year ended 31 March 1949, so the story dates the erection to fiscal 1948-49 rather than calendar 1948; the 1947 purchase is likewise dated to fiscal 1947-48. The 1947 entry is also a transcription. Gap: the sources do not explain how the 1948 tower gives way to the 2004 tower. The story does not claim a replacement or a rebuild on the same spot. Access level 'closed' is carried from the brief's record; no source read states a closure, and the layer's access mode is drive. The province classes the wildfire lookout layer as Protected; the story uses only the year, height, type, access mode and active flag, with no coordinates or map. Staffing is a province-wide statement from the Alberta.ca page, not a site-specific record. Reads: 2 web searches and about 6 page or query reads across the three towers. No photos added; licences were not checked.
